edition.name: Mahāvīracariu
edition.publication: Journal of the Oriental Institute Baroda

blurb: A fourteenth-century text of twenty-four verses in Apabhraṃśa summarizing the sacred life of Mahāvīrasvāmī, the twenty-fourth and final Tīrthaṅkara of the present cosmic cycle. An important document of late medieval Jaina vernacular literary tradition.
about: The text — Mahāvīracariu — first appeared in the Journal of the Oriental Institute, Baroda, in Vol. 24 (the 2500 Years of Mahāvīra Nirvāṇa special issue). It was edited from a single palm-leaf manuscript at the Khetarvasahi Pāṭaka Jaina Jñāna Bhaṇḍāra, Patan (Gujarat), by Ramaniklal M. Shah. This short text of 24 verses is authored by Jinaprabhasūri, who flourished in the early 14th century C.E. He also authored Prākṛta works such as Gautama Pṛcchā and Viveka Kulaka, and Apabhraṃśa works such as Jambūcarita, Mallinātha-Carita, and Subhāṣitakulaka. The poet skilfully weaves his own name into the last word of verse 22.
overview: Verses 6–9: Main events of the life of Mahāvīrasvāmī
Verses 14–19: The Śramaṇa tradition till Duppasahasūri

padas.deva:
सुमरिवि सिरिजिणवद्धमाणु गुणमणिरयणायरु
तासु चरिउ जंपेमि किंपि वेरग्गह आयरु।
अवरविदेहे गामसामि नयसारुऽभिहाणु
अडविसमणपहगमणसम्मु सोहम्मविमाणु॥
padas.iast:
sumarivi sirijiṇavaddhamāṇu guṇamaṇirayaṇāyaru
tāsu cariu jaṃpemi kiṃpi veraggaha āyaru.
avaravidehe gāmasāmi nayasāru'bhihāṇu
aḍavisamaṇapahagamaṇasammu sohammavimāṇu..
padas.iso:
sumarivi sirijiṇavaddhamāṇu guṇamaṇirayaṇāyaru
tāsu cariu jaṁpēmi kiṁpi vēraggaha āyaru.
avaravidēhē gāmasāmi nayasāru’bhihāṇu
aḍavisamaṇapahagamaṇasammu sōhammavimāṇu..
padas.hk:
sumarivi sirijiNavaddhamANu guNamaNirayaNAyaru
tAsu cariu jaMpemi kiMpi veraggaha Ayaru.
avaravidehe gAmasAmi nayasAru'bhihANu
aDavisamaNapahagamaNasammu sohammavimANu..
padas.slp1:
sumarivi sirijiRavadDamARu guRamaRirayaRAyaru
tAsu cariu jaMpemi kiMpi veraggaha Ayaru.
avaravidehe gAmasAmi nayasAru'BihARu
aqavisamaRapahagamaRasammu sohammavimARu..

padas.deva:
सिरिभरहेसरसुउ मरीइ उम्मग्गुवपसिउ
पंचमकप्पे देवु हविउ कुल्लागे कोसिउ।
तउ भवु थूणा पुस्समित्तु सोहम्मे सुरु वरु
चेइय अग्गिज्जोउ बिप्पु ईसाणे हुउ सुरु॥
padas.iast:
siribharahesarasuu marīi ummagguvapasiu
paṃcamakappe devu haviu kullāge kosiu.
taü bhavu thūṇā pussamittu sohamme suru varu
ceiya aggijjou bippu īsāṇe huu suru..
padas.iso:
siribharahēsarasuu marīi ummagguvapasiu
paṁcamakappē dēvu haviu kullāgē kōsiu.
ta:u bhavu thūṇā pussamittu sōhammē suru varu
cēiya aggijjōu bippu īsāṇē huu suru..
padas.hk:
siribharahesarasuu marIi ummagguvapasiu
paMcamakappe devu haviu kullAge kosiu.
ta_u bhavu thUNA pussamittu sohamme suru varu
ceiya aggijjou bippu IsANe huu suru..
padas.slp1:
siriBarahesarasuu marIi ummagguvapasiu
paMcamakappe devu haviu kullAge kosiu.
ta_u Bavu TURA pussamittu sohamme suru varu
ceiya aggijjou bippu IsARe huu suru..

padas.deva:
तउ मंदिरि दिउ अग्गिभूइ तइए कप्पम्मि
देवु चविउ भारद्दगुरु सेयवियपुरम्मि।
तत्तो हूउ माहिंददेवु नउ भमिउ रूवम्मि
थावरमाहणु बंभलोइ पंचमकप्पम्मि॥
padas.iast:
taü maṃdiri diu aggibhūi taïe kappammi
devu caviu bhāraddaguru seyaviyapurammi.
tatto hūu māhiṃdadevu naü bhamiu rūvammi
thāvaramāhaṇu baṃbhaloi paṃcamakappammi..
padas.iso:
ta:u maṁdiri diu aggibhūi ta:iē kappammi
dēvu caviu bhāraddaguru sēyaviyapurammi.
tattō hūu māhiṁdadēvu na:u bhamiu rūvammi
thāvaramāhaṇu baṁbhalōi paṁcamakappammi..
padas.hk:
ta_u maMdiri diu aggibhUi ta_ie kappammi
devu caviu bhAraddaguru seyaviyapurammi.
tatto hUu mAhiMdadevu na_u bhamiu rUvammi
thAvaramAhaNu baMbhaloi paMcamakappammi..
padas.slp1:
ta_u maMdiri diu aggiBUi ta_ie kappammi
devu caviu BAraddaguru seyaviyapurammi.
tatto hUu mAhiMdadevu na_u Bamiu rUvammi
TAvaramAhaRu baMBaloi paMcamakappammi..

padas.deva:
एसु उ पुव्वभवेसु हूउ छस्सु वि परिवायगु
भमिउ भवंतउ रायगेहि निव-सुउ गुणनायगु।
विस्सभूइ मुणि देवु हूउ महसुक्कि सपुन्नु
पोअणपुरे तिविट्ठु नरय-सत्तमि उप्पनु॥
padas.iast:
esu u puvvabhavesu hūu chassu vi parivāyagu
bhamiu bhavaṃtaü rāyagehi niva-suu guṇanāyagu.
vissabhūi muṇi devu hūu mahasukki sapunnu
poaṇapure tiviṭṭhu naraya-sattami uppanu..
padas.iso:
ēsu u puvvabhavēsu hūu chassu vi parivāyagu
bhamiu bhavaṁta:u rāyagēhi niva-suu guṇanāyagu.
vissabhūi muṇi dēvu hūu mahasukki sapunnu
pōaṇapurē tiviṭṭhu naraya-sattami uppanu..
padas.hk:
esu u puvvabhavesu hUu chassu vi parivAyagu
bhamiu bhavaMta_u rAyagehi niva-suu guNanAyagu.
vissabhUi muNi devu hUu mahasukki sapunnu
poaNapure tiviTThu naraya-sattami uppanu..
padas.slp1:
esu u puvvaBavesu hUu Cassu vi parivAyagu
Bamiu BavaMta_u rAyagehi niva-suu guRanAyagu.
vissaBUi muRi devu hUu mahasukki sapunnu
poaRapure tiviwWu naraya-sattami uppanu..

padas.deva:
सीहु नरय तउ तिरिय मणुअ देवो पियमित्तु
चक्की मूअ विदेहवासि हूउ समणु पवित्तु।
सत्तम कप्पे देवु हविउ नंदणु निवनंदणु
मुणि बंधिउ तित्थयरगोत्तु तिहुअणआनंदणु॥
padas.iast:
sīhu naraya taü tiriya maṇua devo piyamittu
cakkī mūa videhavāsi hūu samaṇu pavittu.
sattama kappe devu haviu naṃdaṇu nivanaṃdaṇu
muṇi baṃdhiu titthayaragottu tihuaṇaānaṃdaṇu..
padas.iso:
sīhu naraya ta:u tiriya maṇua dēvō piyamittu
cakkī mūa vidēhavāsi hūu samaṇu pavittu.
sattama kappē dēvu haviu naṁdaṇu nivanaṁdaṇu
muṇi baṁdhiu titthayaragōttu tihuaṇaānaṁdaṇu..
padas.hk:
sIhu naraya ta_u tiriya maNua devo piyamittu
cakkI mUa videhavAsi hUu samaNu pavittu.
sattama kappe devu haviu naMdaNu nivanaMdaNu
muNi baMdhiu titthayaragottu tihuaNaAnaMdaNu..
padas.slp1:
sIhu naraya ta_u tiriya maRua devo piyamittu
cakkI mUa videhavAsi hUu samaRu pavittu.
sattama kappe devu haviu naMdaRu nivanaMdaRu
muRi baMDiu titTayaragottu tihuaRaAnaMdaRu..

padas.deva:
पाणयपुप्फतराउ चविउ नाणत्तयजुत्तु
कुंडगाम सिद्धत्थ-राउ तिसलादेवि पुत्तु।
तीस वरिस कुमरत्ति वसिउ पडिवज्जिउ संजमु
दुस्सहु सहि उवसग्गवग्गु सिय-झाणु अणोवमु॥
padas.iast:
pāṇayapupphatarāu caviu nāṇattayajuttu
kuṃḍagāma siddhattha-rāu tisalādevi puttu.
tīsa varisa kumaratti vasiu paḍivajjiu saṃjamu
dussahu sahi uvasaggavaggu siya-jhāṇu aṇovamu..
padas.iso:
pāṇayapupphatarāu caviu nāṇattayajuttu
kuṁḍagāma siddhattha-rāu tisalādēvi puttu.
tīsa varisa kumaratti vasiu paḍivajjiu saṁjamu
dussahu sahi uvasaggavaggu siya-jhāṇu aṇōvamu..
padas.hk:
pANayapupphatarAu caviu nANattayajuttu
kuMDagAma siddhattha-rAu tisalAdevi puttu.
tIsa varisa kumaratti vasiu paDivajjiu saMjamu
dussahu sahi uvasaggavaggu siya-jhANu aNovamu..
padas.slp1:
pARayapupPatarAu caviu nARattayajuttu
kuMqagAma sidDatTa-rAu tisalAdevi puttu.
tIsa varisa kumaratti vasiu paqivajjiu saMjamu
dussahu sahi uvasaggavaggu siya-JARu aRovamu..

padas.deva:
घाईकम्म अणाइनिहण निहणिउ इह बहुविहु
पाविय केवलनाणलच्छि किउ संघु चउचिहु।
गोअम-पमुहा दिव्व-नाण एगारस गणहर
चंदनबाल पवित्तिणी य तियलोय-मणोहर॥
padas.iast:
ghāīkamma aṇāinihaṇa nihaṇiu iha bahuvihu
pāviya kevalanāṇalacchi kiu saṃghu caücihu.
goama-pamuhā divva-nāṇa egārasa gaṇahara
caṃdanabāla pavittiṇī ya tiyaloya-maṇohara..
padas.iso:
ghāīkamma aṇāinihaṇa nihaṇiu iha bahuvihu
pāviya kēvalanāṇalacchi kiu saṁghu ca:ucihu.
gōama-pamuhā divva-nāṇa ēgārasa gaṇahara
caṁdanabāla pavittiṇī ya tiyalōya-maṇōhara..
padas.hk:
ghAIkamma aNAinihaNa nihaNiu iha bahuvihu
pAviya kevalanANalacchi kiu saMghu ca_ucihu.
goama-pamuhA divva-nANa egArasa gaNahara
caMdanabAla pavittiNI ya tiyaloya-maNohara..
padas.slp1:
GAIkamma aRAinihaRa nihaRiu iha bahuvihu
pAviya kevalanARalacCi kiu saMGu ca_ucihu.
goama-pamuhA divva-nARa egArasa gaRahara
caMdanabAla pavittiRI ya tiyaloya-maRohara..

padas.deva:
चउदस सहस मुणीण सहस छत्तीस य अज्जिय
एगुणसट्ठि सहस्सु लक्खु सावग गुण-सज्जिय।
तिन्नि लक्ख अट्ठारस सहस साविय सुसमाहिय
निम्मल-नाण-समत्त जुत्त भव-भावण भाविय॥
padas.iast:
caüdasa sahasa muṇīṇa sahasa chattīsa ya ajjiya
eguṇasaṭṭhi sahassu lakkhu sāvaga guṇa-sajjiya.
tinni lakkha aṭṭhārasa sahasa sāviya susamāhiya
nimmala-nāṇa-samatta jutta bhava-bhāvaṇa bhāviya..
padas.iso:
ca:udasa sahasa muṇīṇa sahasa chattīsa ya ajjiya
ēguṇasaṭṭhi sahassu lakkhu sāvaga guṇa-sajjiya.
tinni lakkha aṭṭhārasa sahasa sāviya susamāhiya
nimmala-nāṇa-samatta jutta bhava-bhāvaṇa bhāviya..
padas.hk:
ca_udasa sahasa muNINa sahasa chattIsa ya ajjiya
eguNasaTThi sahassu lakkhu sAvaga guNa-sajjiya.
tinni lakkha aTThArasa sahasa sAviya susamAhiya
nimmala-nANa-samatta jutta bhava-bhAvaNa bhAviya..
padas.slp1:
ca_udasa sahasa muRIRa sahasa CattIsa ya ajjiya
eguRasawWi sahassu lakKu sAvaga guRa-sajjiya.
tinni lakKa awWArasa sahasa sAviya susamAhiya
nimmala-nARa-samatta jutta Bava-BAvaRa BAviya..

padas.deva:
एवं चउविहु संघु विहिउ पडिबोहिउ भवियणु
इय सिरिवीरजिणिंदचंदु पावइ सिद्धत्तणु।
दुब्भासियएगेण चेव जई जिणवरजीविण
कोडाकोडीसायराण भवु भमिउ य समविण॥
padas.iast:
evaṃ caüvihu saṃghu vihiu paḍibohiu bhaviyaṇu
iya sirivīrajiṇiṃdacaṃdu pāvaï siddhattaṇu.
dubbhāsiyaegeṇa ceva jaī jiṇavarajīviṇa
koḍākoḍīsāyarāṇa bhavu bhamiu ya samaviṇa..
padas.iso:
ēvaṁ ca:uvihu saṁghu vihiu paḍibōhiu bhaviyaṇu
iya sirivīrajiṇiṁdacaṁdu pāva:i siddhattaṇu.
dubbhāsiyaēgēṇa cēva jaī jiṇavarajīviṇa
kōḍākōḍīsāyarāṇa bhavu bhamiu ya samaviṇa..
padas.hk:
evaM ca_uvihu saMghu vihiu paDibohiu bhaviyaNu
iya sirivIrajiNiMdacaMdu pAva_i siddhattaNu.
dubbhAsiyaegeNa ceva jaI jiNavarajIviNa
koDAkoDIsAyarANa bhavu bhamiu ya samaviNa..
padas.slp1:
evaM ca_uvihu saMGu vihiu paqibohiu BaviyaRu
iya sirivIrajiRiMdacaMdu pAva_i sidDattaRu.
dubBAsiyaegeRa ceva jaI jiRavarajIviRa
koqAkoqIsAyarARa Bavu Bamiu ya samaviRa..

padas.deva:
ता भो भवियह अप्पमत्त उवसमु मा मेल्हहु
जेंव तुम्हि अविग्घु सिग्घु सिद्धहं पुरि खेल्लहु
जीवह जिणवरआणभंगि हुइ दंडु पयंडु
ता कुण जिणआणाए सव्वऽणुट्ठाणु अखंडु॥
padas.iast:
tā bho bhaviyaha appamatta uvasamu mā melhahu
jeṃva tumhi avigghu sigghu siddhahaṃ puri khellahu
jīvaha jiṇavaraāṇabhaṃgi hui daṃḍu payaṃḍu
tā kuṇa jiṇaāṇāe savva'ṇuṭṭhāṇu akhaṃḍu..
padas.iso:
tā bhō bhaviyaha appamatta uvasamu mā mēlhahu
jēṁva tumhi avigghu sigghu siddhahaṁ puri khēllahu
jīvaha jiṇavaraāṇabhaṁgi hui daṁḍu payaṁḍu
tā kuṇa jiṇaāṇāē savva’ṇuṭṭhāṇu akhaṁḍu..
padas.hk:
tA bho bhaviyaha appamatta uvasamu mA melhahu
jeMva tumhi avigghu sigghu siddhahaM puri khellahu
jIvaha jiNavaraANabhaMgi hui daMDu payaMDu
tA kuNa jiNaANAe savva'NuTThANu akhaMDu..
padas.slp1:
tA Bo Baviyaha appamatta uvasamu mA melhahu
jeMva tumhi avigGu sigGu sidDahaM puri Kellahu
jIvaha jiRavaraARaBaMgi hui daMqu payaMqu
tA kuRa jiRaARAe savva'RuwWARu aKaMqu..

padas.deva:
तिहुअणजगडणु मोहचरड रयणत्तय चोरिय
नट्ठा जिय जिणराय सुहड अविहड परिवारिय।
रागदोससुहडेहिं दोहिं कोवि हु तहिं पाडिय
पच्छा नेविणु मोह गुत्ति संरुद्धा साडिय॥
padas.iast:
tihuaṇajagaḍaṇu mohacaraḍa rayaṇattaya coriya
naṭṭhā jiya jiṇarāya suhaḍa avihaḍa parivāriya.
rāgadosasuhaḍehiṃ dohiṃ kovi hu tahiṃ pāḍiya
pacchā neviṇu moha gutti saṃruddhā sāḍiya..
padas.iso:
tihuaṇajagaḍaṇu mōhacaraḍa rayaṇattaya cōriya
naṭṭhā jiya jiṇarāya suhaḍa avihaḍa parivāriya.
rāgadōsasuhaḍēhiṁ dōhiṁ kōvi hu tahiṁ pāḍiya
pacchā nēviṇu mōha gutti saṁruddhā sāḍiya..
padas.hk:
tihuaNajagaDaNu mohacaraDa rayaNattaya coriya
naTThA jiya jiNarAya suhaDa avihaDa parivAriya.
rAgadosasuhaDehiM dohiM kovi hu tahiM pADiya
pacchA neviNu moha gutti saMruddhA sADiya..
padas.slp1:
tihuaRajagaqaRu mohacaraqa rayaRattaya coriya
nawWA jiya jiRarAya suhaqa avihaqa parivAriya.
rAgadosasuhaqehiM dohiM kovi hu tahiM pAqiya
pacCA neviRu moha gutti saMrudDA sAqiya..

padas.deva:
केई पुण सुह-कम्मवसिण उल्लसिय सुवीरिय
निरुवम उवसमगढ पविट्ठ मोहह मसि चीरिय
वीराय निरवाय पायं पणिवाय पणासिय
राग-दोस दहकोस पसम परितोसिय॥
padas.iast:
keī puṇa suha-kammavasiṇa ullasiya suvīriya
niruvama uvasamagaḍha paviṭṭha mohaha masi cīriya
vīrāya niravāya pāyaṃ paṇivāya paṇāsiya
rāga-dosa dahakosa pasama paritosiya..
padas.iso:
kēī puṇa suha-kammavasiṇa ullasiya suvīriya
niruvama uvasamagaḍha paviṭṭha mōhaha masi cīriya
vīrāya niravāya pāyaṁ paṇivāya paṇāsiya
rāga-dōsa dahakōsa pasama paritōsiya..
padas.hk:
keI puNa suha-kammavasiNa ullasiya suvIriya
niruvama uvasamagaDha paviTTha mohaha masi cIriya
vIrAya niravAya pAyaM paNivAya paNAsiya
rAga-dosa dahakosa pasama paritosiya..
padas.slp1:
keI puRa suha-kammavasiRa ullasiya suvIriya
niruvama uvasamagQaa paviwWa mohaha masi cIriya
vIrAya niravAya pAyaM paRivAya paRAsiya
rAga-dosa dahakosa pasama paritosiya..

padas.deva:
अणुवमु सासय-सुक्खु मोक्खु लक्खिउ दुल्लक्खु वि
तेहि जं न कयावि लहइ वागरिणिहिं दक्खु वि
दाणु नाणु वक्खाणु झाणुऽणुट्ठाणु गरिट्ठु
जं जिण-आण दिट्ठु सुट्ठु तं चिय सुविसिट्ठु॥
padas.iast:
aṇuvamu sāsaya-sukkhu mokkhu lakkhiu dullakkhu vi
tehi jaṃ na kayāvi lahaï vāgariṇihiṃ dakkhu vi
dāṇu nāṇu vakkhāṇu jhāṇu'ṇuṭṭhāṇu gariṭṭhu
jaṃ jiṇa-āṇa diṭṭhu suṭṭhu taṃ ciya suvisiṭṭhu..
padas.iso:
aṇuvamu sāsaya-sukkhu mōkkhu lakkhiu dullakkhu vi
tēhi jaṁ na kayāvi laha:i vāgariṇihiṁ dakkhu vi
dāṇu nāṇu vakkhāṇu jhāṇu’ṇuṭṭhāṇu gariṭṭhu
jaṁ jiṇa-āṇa diṭṭhu suṭṭhu taṁ ciya suvisiṭṭhu..
padas.hk:
aNuvamu sAsaya-sukkhu mokkhu lakkhiu dullakkhu vi
tehi jaM na kayAvi laha_i vAgariNihiM dakkhu vi
dANu nANu vakkhANu jhANu'NuTThANu gariTThu
jaM jiNa-ANa diTThu suTThu taM ciya suvisiTThu..
padas.slp1:
aRuvamu sAsaya-sukKu mokKu lakKiu dullakKu vi
tehi jaM na kayAvi laha_i vAgariRihiM dakKu vi
dARu nARu vakKARu JARu'RuwWARu gariwWu
jaM jiRa-ARa diwWu suwWu taM ciya suvisiwWu..

padas.deva:
सामिय वीरजिणिंदचंद गणहर हारोवम
नायगु सोहइ सुहमसामि तसु पय कमलसम
जंबूसामी पभवसूरि सिज्जंभवसूरि
तासु पट्टि जसमद्दसूरि मुणिगणगुणभूरि॥
padas.iast:
sāmiya vīrajiṇiṃdacaṃda gaṇahara hārovama
nāyagu sohaï suhamasāmi tasu paya kamalasama
jaṃbūsāmī pabhavasūri sijjaṃbhavasūri
tāsu paṭṭi jasamaddasūri muṇigaṇaguṇabhūri..
padas.iso:
sāmiya vīrajiṇiṁdacaṁda gaṇahara hārōvama
nāyagu sōha:i suhamasāmi tasu paya kamalasama
jaṁbūsāmī pabhavasūri sijjaṁbhavasūri
tāsu paṭṭi jasamaddasūri muṇigaṇaguṇabhūri..
padas.hk:
sAmiya vIrajiNiMdacaMda gaNahara hArovama
nAyagu soha_i suhamasAmi tasu paya kamalasama
jaMbUsAmI pabhavasUri sijjaMbhavasUri
tAsu paTTi jasamaddasUri muNigaNaguNabhUri..
padas.slp1:
sAmiya vIrajiRiMdacaMda gaRahara hArovama
nAyagu soha_i suhamasAmi tasu paya kamalasama
jaMbUsAmI paBavasUri sijjaMBavasUri
tAsu pawwi jasamaddasUri muRigaRaguRaBUri..

padas.deva:
तसु पय सिरि-संभूविजयसूरि पाव-पणासणु
भद्दवाहु मुणिनाहु जयउ पयडियजिणसासणु
भावि भद्द सिरिथूलभद्द मुनि पहु सुअसायरु
अज्जमहागिरिसूरि विहिउ जिणकप्पह आयरु॥
padas.iast:
tasu paya siri-saṃbhūvijayasūri pāva-paṇāsaṇu
bhaddavāhu muṇināhu jayaü payaḍiyajiṇasāsaṇu
bhāvi bhadda sirithūlabhadda muni pahu suasāyaru
ajjamahāgirisūri vihiu jiṇakappaha āyaru..
padas.iso:
tasu paya siri-saṁbhūvijayasūri pāva-paṇāsaṇu
bhaddavāhu muṇināhu jaya:u payaḍiyajiṇasāsaṇu
bhāvi bhadda sirithūlabhadda muni pahu suasāyaru
ajjamahāgirisūri vihiu jiṇakappaha āyaru..
padas.hk:
tasu paya siri-saMbhUvijayasUri pAva-paNAsaNu
bhaddavAhu muNinAhu jaya_u payaDiyajiNasAsaNu
bhAvi bhadda sirithUlabhadda muni pahu suasAyaru
ajjamahAgirisUri vihiu jiNakappaha Ayaru..
padas.slp1:
tasu paya siri-saMBUvijayasUri pAva-paRAsaRu
BaddavAhu muRinAhu jaya_u payaqiyajiRasAsaRu
BAvi Badda siriTUlaBadda muni pahu suasAyaru
ajjamahAgirisUri vihiu jiRakappaha Ayaru..

padas.deva:
अज्जसुहत्थिपमुह सूरि जिणतित्थपभावग
जावह हूउ सिरिवयरसामि गुणसंघह नायग
आजम्मु वि चारित्तवित्तु जीणिहिं बहु फरसिउ
निरुवमदंसणनाणरम्मु जिणधम्मु पयासि॥
padas.iast:
ajjasuhatthipamuha sūri jiṇatitthapabhāvaga
jāvaha hūu sirivayarasāmi guṇasaṃghaha nāyaga
ājammu vi cārittavittu jīṇihiṃ bahu pharasiu
niruvamadaṃsaṇanāṇarammu jiṇadhammu payāsi..
padas.iso:
ajjasuhatthipamuha sūri jiṇatitthapabhāvaga
jāvaha hūu sirivayarasāmi guṇasaṁghaha nāyaga
ājammu vi cārittavittu jīṇihiṁ bahu pharasiu
niruvamadaṁsaṇanāṇarammu jiṇadhammu payāsi..
padas.hk:
ajjasuhatthipamuha sUri jiNatitthapabhAvaga
jAvaha hUu sirivayarasAmi guNasaMghaha nAyaga
Ajammu vi cArittavittu jINihiM bahu pharasiu
niruvamadaMsaNanANarammu jiNadhammu payAsi..
padas.slp1:
ajjasuhatTipamuha sUri jiRatitTapaBAvaga
jAvaha hUu sirivayarasAmi guRasaMGaha nAyaga
Ajammu vi cArittavittu jIRihiM bahu Parasiu
niruvamadaMsaRanARarammu jiRaDammu payAsi..

padas.deva:
सु हु गुरुदिक्खिउ जाव अज्जरक्खिउ सुपरिक्खिउ
रयणकरंडसमाणु ओगु इह जीणिहिं रक्खिउ।
सिरिसीमंधरसामिएण समसरणिऽभिनंदिउ
जो नियखेत्ताणं दविंददेविंदिहिं वंदिउ
padas.iast:
su hu gurudikkhiu jāva ajjarakkhiu suparikkhiu
rayaṇakaraṃḍasamāṇu ogu iha jīṇihiṃ rakkhiu.
sirisīmaṃdharasāmieṇa samasaraṇi'bhinaṃdiu
jo niyakhettāṇaṃ daviṃdadeviṃdihiṃ vaṃdiu
padas.iso:
su hu gurudikkhiu jāva ajjarakkhiu suparikkhiu
rayaṇakaraṁḍasamāṇu ōgu iha jīṇihiṁ rakkhiu.
sirisīmaṁdharasāmiēṇa samasaraṇi’bhinaṁdiu
jō niyakhēttāṇaṁ daviṁdadēviṁdihiṁ vaṁdiu
padas.hk:
su hu gurudikkhiu jAva ajjarakkhiu suparikkhiu
rayaNakaraMDasamANu ogu iha jINihiM rakkhiu.
sirisImaMdharasAmieNa samasaraNi'bhinaMdiu
jo niyakhettANaM daviMdadeviMdihiM vaMdiu
padas.slp1:
su hu gurudikKiu jAva ajjarakKiu suparikKiu
rayaRakaraMqasamARu ogu iha jIRihiM rakKiu.
sirisImaMDarasAmieRa samasaraRi'BinaMdiu
jo niyaKettARaM daviMdadeviMdihiM vaMdiu

padas.deva:
जह जिनवरिहिं निगोअजीव संसिय वरनाणिहिं
तह वक्खाणिय रक्खियज्जसूरिहिं सुयनाणिहिं
वद्धमाणु जिणतित्थि जाव दुप्पसहु गणाहिवु
जसु पयपंकय छप्पय व्व सेविसइ सुराहिवु॥
padas.iast:
jaha jinavarihiṃ nigoajīva saṃsiya varanāṇihiṃ
taha vakkhāṇiya rakkhiyajjasūrihiṃ suyanāṇihiṃ
vaddhamāṇu jiṇatitthi jāva duppasahu gaṇāhivu
jasu payapaṃkaya chappaya vva sevisaï surāhivu..
padas.iso:
jaha jinavarihiṁ nigōajīva saṁsiya varanāṇihiṁ
taha vakkhāṇiya rakkhiyajjasūrihiṁ suyanāṇihiṁ
vaddhamāṇu jiṇatitthi jāva duppasahu gaṇāhivu
jasu payapaṁkaya chappaya vva sēvisa:i surāhivu..
padas.hk:
jaha jinavarihiM nigoajIva saMsiya varanANihiM
taha vakkhANiya rakkhiyajjasUrihiM suyanANihiM
vaddhamANu jiNatitthi jAva duppasahu gaNAhivu
jasu payapaMkaya chappaya vva sevisa_i surAhivu..
padas.slp1:
jaha jinavarihiM nigoajIva saMsiya varanARihiM
taha vakKARiya rakKiyajjasUrihiM suyanARihiM
vadDamARu jiRatitTi jAva duppasahu gaRAhivu
jasu payapaMkaya Cappaya vva sevisa_i surAhivu..

padas.deva:
तसु तित्थह माहप्पकप्पु सक्कु वि न हु सक्कइ
वन्निउ किं पुण अम्ह सरिसु इह मज्झि निलुक्कइ।
भरहखेत्तु सुपवित्तु ईणि अज्ज वि य पयट्टह
तह वि मुढू जणु एउ कत्थ वि अन्नत्थ वि तुट्ठउ॥
padas.iast:
tasu titthaha māhappakappu sakku vi na hu sakkaï
vanniu kiṃ puṇa amha sarisu iha majjhi nilukkaï.
bharahakhettu supavittu īṇi ajja vi ya payaṭṭaha
taha vi muḍhū jaṇu eu kattha vi annattha vi tuṭṭhaü..
padas.iso:
tasu titthaha māhappakappu sakku vi na hu sakka:i
vanniu kiṁ puṇa amha sarisu iha majjhi nilukka:i.
bharahakhēttu supavittu īṇi ajja vi ya payaṭṭaha
taha vi muḍhū jaṇu ēu kattha vi annattha vi tuṭṭha:u..
padas.hk:
tasu titthaha mAhappakappu sakku vi na hu sakka_i
vanniu kiM puNa amha sarisu iha majjhi nilukka_i.
bharahakhettu supavittu INi ajja vi ya payaTTaha
taha vi muDhU jaNu eu kattha vi annattha vi tuTTha_u..
padas.slp1:
tasu titTaha mAhappakappu sakku vi na hu sakka_i
vanniu kiM puRa amha sarisu iha majJi nilukka_i.
BarahaKettu supavittu IRi ajja vi ya payawwaha
taha vi muQU jaRu eu katTa vi annatTa vi tuwWa_u..

padas.deva:
गब्भहरण उवसग्गकरण चमरिंदुप्पायण
परिसअभाविय चंदसूर सविमाणावयरण।
भाविय भावा हुंति हुंडअवसप्पिणि लक्खणु
परिणइ कम्मवसेण जियहं किं कुणइ वियक्खणु॥
padas.iast:
gabbhaharaṇa uvasaggakaraṇa camariṃduppāyaṇa
parisaabhāviya caṃdasūra savimāṇāvayaraṇa.
bhāviya bhāvā huṃti huṃḍaavasappiṇi lakkhaṇu
pariṇaï kammavaseṇa jiyahaṃ kiṃ kuṇaï viyakkhaṇu..
padas.iso:
gabbhaharaṇa uvasaggakaraṇa camariṁduppāyaṇa
parisaabhāviya caṁdasūra savimāṇāvayaraṇa.
bhāviya bhāvā huṁti huṁḍaavasappiṇi lakkhaṇu
pariṇa:i kammavasēṇa jiyahaṁ kiṁ kuṇa:i viyakkhaṇu..
padas.hk:
gabbhaharaNa uvasaggakaraNa camariMduppAyaNa
parisaabhAviya caMdasUra savimANAvayaraNa.
bhAviya bhAvA huMti huMDaavasappiNi lakkhaNu
pariNa_i kammavaseNa jiyahaM kiM kuNa_i viyakkhaNu..
padas.slp1:
gabBaharaRa uvasaggakaraRa camariMduppAyaRa
parisaaBAviya caMdasUra savimARAvayaraRa.
BAviya BAvA huMti huMqaavasappiRi lakKaRu
pariRa_i kammavaseRa jiyahaM kiM kuRa_i viyakKaRu..

padas.deva:
आसाधह सिय छट्ठि चवणु चेत्तुज्जलतेरसि
जम्मु रम्मु कसिणाए दसमि मग्गह वउस्सव (?) सि।
वइसाहह सियदसमि नाणु उत्पन्न सामिय
कत्तियऽमावस सिद्धि-गमणु भुवणत्तय पणमिय॥
padas.iast:
āsādhaha siya chaṭṭhi cavaṇu cettujjalaterasi
jammu rammu kasiṇāe dasami maggaha vaüssava (?) si.
vaïsāhaha siyadasami nāṇu utpanna sāmiya
kattiya'māvasa siddhi-gamaṇu bhuvaṇattaya paṇamiya..
padas.iso:
āsādhaha siya chaṭṭhi cavaṇu cēttujjalatērasi
jammu rammu kasiṇāē dasami maggaha va:ussava (?) si.
va:isāhaha siyadasami nāṇu utpanna sāmiya
kattiya’māvasa siddhi-gamaṇu bhuvaṇattaya paṇamiya..
padas.hk:
AsAdhaha siya chaTThi cavaNu cettujjalaterasi
jammu rammu kasiNAe dasami maggaha va_ussava (?) si.
va_isAhaha siyadasami nANu utpanna sAmiya
kattiya'mAvasa siddhi-gamaNu bhuvaNattaya paNamiya..
padas.slp1:
AsADaha siya CawWi cavaRu cettujjalaterasi
jammu rammu kasiRAe dasami maggaha va_ussava (?) si.
va_isAhaha siyadasami nARu utpanna sAmiya
kattiya'mAvasa sidDi-gamaRu BuvaRattaya paRamiya..

padas.deva:
सत्त-हत्थ-तणु-माणु सीहलंछणु कणयप्पहु
पहणिउ कीणिहिं भवियजणहं दुहुऽणंतु जु कुप्पहु।
सो सामिउ देवाहिदेवु सुपयासियसिवपहु
संघह मंगलु सगलु देउ चउवीसमु जिणपहु॥
padas.iast:
satta-hattha-taṇu-māṇu sīhalaṃchaṇu kaṇayappahu
pahaṇiu kīṇihiṃ bhaviyajaṇahaṃ duhu'ṇaṃtu ju kuppahu.
so sāmiu devāhidevu supayāsiyasivapahu
saṃghaha maṃgalu sagalu deu caüvīsamu jiṇapahu..
padas.iso:
satta-hattha-taṇu-māṇu sīhalaṁchaṇu kaṇayappahu
pahaṇiu kīṇihiṁ bhaviyajaṇahaṁ duhu’ṇaṁtu ju kuppahu.
sō sāmiu dēvāhidēvu supayāsiyasivapahu
saṁghaha maṁgalu sagalu dēu ca:uvīsamu jiṇapahu..
padas.hk:
satta-hattha-taNu-mANu sIhalaMchaNu kaNayappahu
pahaNiu kINihiM bhaviyajaNahaM duhu'NaMtu ju kuppahu.
so sAmiu devAhidevu supayAsiyasivapahu
saMghaha maMgalu sagalu deu ca_uvIsamu jiNapahu..
padas.slp1:
satta-hatTa-taRu-mARu sIhalaMCaRu kaRayappahu
pahaRiu kIRihiM BaviyajaRahaM duhu'RaMtu ju kuppahu.
so sAmiu devAhidevu supayAsiyasivapahu
saMGaha maMgalu sagalu deu ca_uvIsamu jiRapahu..

padas.deva:
विहरिय विहरंति देव विहरिस्सइं जिणवर
मणुअखेत्तसु पवित्तकरण सच्चरणमणोहर।
निरुवमअइसयसंपयाहिं उवसोहिय सव्विहिं
तेहिं पणमउं पइदिणं पि सूरग्गमि सुयविहिं॥
padas.iast:
vihariya viharaṃti deva viharissaïṃ jiṇavara
maṇuakhettasu pavittakaraṇa saccaraṇamaṇohara.
niruvamaaïsayasaṃpayāhiṃ uvasohiya savvihiṃ
tehiṃ paṇamaüṃ païdiṇaṃ pi sūraggami suyavihiṃ..
padas.iso:
vihariya viharaṁti dēva viharissa:iṁ jiṇavara
maṇuakhēttasu pavittakaraṇa saccaraṇamaṇōhara.
niruvamaa:isayasaṁpayāhiṁ uvasōhiya savvihiṁ
tēhiṁ paṇama:uṁ pa:idiṇaṁ pi sūraggami suyavihiṁ..
padas.hk:
vihariya viharaMti deva viharissa_iM jiNavara
maNuakhettasu pavittakaraNa saccaraNamaNohara.
niruvamaa_isayasaMpayAhiM uvasohiya savvihiM
tehiM paNama_uM pa_idiNaM pi sUraggami suyavihiM..
padas.slp1:
vihariya viharaMti deva viharissa_iM jiRavara
maRuaKettasu pavittakaraRa saccaraRamaRohara.
niruvamaa_isayasaMpayAhiM uvasohiya savvihiM
tehiM paRama_uM pa_idiRaM pi sUraggami suyavihiM..

padas.deva:
पणमं सिरिअरहंतसिद्धगणहरउवज्झायहं
समणहं सुमणहं सव्वलोअसमभावसमायहं
इय पंचहं नवकारु सारु संसारतरंडहं
पढमं मंगल होइ लोइ गुणरयणकरंडहं॥
padas.iast:
paṇamaṃ siriarahaṃtasiddhagaṇaharaüvajjhāyahaṃ
samaṇahaṃ sumaṇahaṃ savvaloasamabhāvasamāyahaṃ
iya paṃcahaṃ navakāru sāru saṃsārataraṃḍahaṃ
paḍhamaṃ maṃgala hoi loi guṇarayaṇakaraṃḍahaṃ..
padas.iso:
paṇamaṁ siriarahaṁtasiddhagaṇahara:uvajjhāyahaṁ
samaṇahaṁ sumaṇahaṁ savvalōasamabhāvasamāyahaṁ
iya paṁcahaṁ navakāru sāru saṁsārataraṁḍahaṁ
paḍhamaṁ maṁgala hōi lōi guṇarayaṇakaraṁḍahaṁ..
padas.hk:
paNamaM siriarahaMtasiddhagaNahara_uvajjhAyahaM
samaNahaM sumaNahaM savvaloasamabhAvasamAyahaM
iya paMcahaM navakAru sAru saMsArataraMDahaM
paDhamaM maMgala hoi loi guNarayaNakaraMDahaM..
padas.slp1:
paRamaM siriarahaMtasidDagaRahara_uvajJAyahaM
samaRahaM sumaRahaM savvaloasamaBAvasamAyahaM
iya paMcahaM navakAru sAru saMsArataraMqahaM
pQaamaM maMgala hoi loi guRarayaRakaraMqahaM..
